subject: Copywriting
title: Numbers and Brackets in Subjects
description: A micro-lesson that makes Numbers and Brackets in Subjects usable.

hook.text: '[New] 5 tips for better sleep' gets 30% more opens than 'Tips for better sleep.' Numbers plus brackets equal attention.

buildup.text: Numbers create specificity. '5 tips' feels finite and manageable. 'Tips' feels vague and endless.

discovery.text: Brackets add a visual break in the inbox. [Video], [Free], [Urgent]—these tags help eyes latch on amid clutter.

twist.text: Odd numbers outperform even ones. 7 tips beats 6 tips. The brain finds odd numbers more interesting and memorable.

climax.text: HubSpot's analysis of 6.4 billion emails confirmed: subjects with numbers get 15% more clicks than numberless ones.

punchline.text: Add a number. Add a bracket. Simple formatting wins opens.

quiz.question: Which performs better in email subjects?

details.summary: Subject lines containing numbers and brackets consistently outperform those without. Numbers provide specificity and set expectations. details.whyItMatters: Small formatting choices in subject lines produce measurable improvements in open rates. Knowing these patterns helps email writers optimize every send with minimal effort.
takeaways: Numbers in subject lines increase open rates by providing specificity
Brackets signal content type and boost engagement by 20-30%
Odd numbers tend to outperform even numbers in testing

faq.question: Why do numbers improve subject line performance?
faq.answer: Numbers stand out visually in a text-heavy inbox. They also set clear expectations — '7 tips' tells the reader exactly what they'll get. Specificity signals preparation and value, making the email feel more worthwhile to open.

faq.question: What types of brackets work best in subject lines?
faq.answer: Content-type brackets like [VIDEO], [REPORT], or [CASE STUDY] perform well because they help readers quickly assess relevance. Urgency brackets like [LAST CHANCE] or [24 HRS] also work but should be used sparingly to avoid fatigue.
